navigation_principles: Keep important contact or service actions discoverable.
Support search when the content inventory justifies it.
Maintain consistent navigation across related pages.
Provide mobile navigation with equivalent functionality.
Separate portal login from public content navigation.

candidate_models.suitable_when: Distinct audiences have substantially different journeys.
Visitors primarily evaluate products or technical solutions.
Visitors search, compare, or connect with service providers.

validation_questions: What are the three most important visitor tasks?
Which audiences need separate navigation paths?
Which CTA represents the primary business objective?
Does the existing website have navigation patterns users depend on?
